title: Raise conditional κ to 0.003890115286352 with a 268-factor single band
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.003890115286352** for the complete paired integer multiplier. This improves [#8032](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8032) by exactly `0.000000000000022`. The largest binary rank exponent falls from `114688000000000` to `112000000000000` and the sufficient public activation exponent falls from `136798773006437` to `119466661575676`.

For every paid rank above the split cap, concavity bounds all the physical parts, including its final remainder. Bounding the excess over the unsplit moment gives a paid-tail coefficient of `1/64` at the exact tilt, compared with the prior `2`. The 268-factor certificate charges the complete 21-bit BIT and 10-bit positive debits through all six ordinary stages and the signed application. It retains the original physical 36-call BIT and 48-call rational inventories. The fixed-word directed raw upper is `0.003890115286594461129996943`.

- The complete comparison is #8032 at `9c5881ab4015854c68d5f5a3fc7d97f68505cc4c`. #8031 bounds weighted source complements on the larger delayed-cover machine. #8026 treats small paid remainders on a different 451-factor source. The present proof prices every split above the cap on #8030's physical single-band word.

## Replay and scope

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-single-band-split-tariff
```

All eight registered cases passed in 675.05 seconds locally on CPython 3.12 from the committed tree. They cover two directed price engines, exact rank and activation budgets, integer loans and fringes, a dense transform, the literal BIT atlas, the rational grid and physical caller, and signed recovery with 138 tape shuttles and 157,248 numerical calls. The price checker rejects the old split majorant at this trial, one additional paid rank-one entry, a corrupted ordinary cap and equality at the signed gate.

The five inherited premises cover all-column native action, owned erasure and restoration, compiler transfer, precision and tape services, and analytic recovery. The production-scale requirements are established by the written proof and exact arithmetic. Executed tape controls are finite. A practical crossover remains open.

## Open next questions
